LanguageData.ShiftChange_Settings_Intro: Colonists clock into Sleep, Cook / Doctor / Animals work, or Ideology rituals, walk to a wardrobe stockpile, put on the assigned apparel policy, then restore previous clothes when the shift ends. Configure per-pawn rules on the Shift Change tab.
LanguageData.ShiftChange_Settings_EnabledTip: Master switch. When off, no automatic apply/restore jobs run.
LanguageData.ShiftChange_Settings_WorkTriggersTip: When a matching work job is issued, change into that rule's kit before settling into the task.
LanguageData.ShiftChange_Settings_RitualTriggersTip: When a colonist joins an Ideology ritual lord, apply their Ritual outfit.
LanguageData.ShiftChange_Settings_PreferInventoryTip: When replacing layers, try inventory first; otherwise drop into the wardrobe zone.
LanguageData.ShiftChange_TabIntro: Per-colonist shift outfits for Sleep, Cook / Doctor / Animals, and Ideology rituals. Colonists walk to the wardrobe, change, then restore when the shift ends.
LanguageData.ShiftChange_TabNoGame: Start or load a game to configure shift rules.
LanguageData.ShiftChange_TabDisabled: Shift Change is disabled in Mod Options.
LanguageData.ShiftChange_TabSelectPawn: Select a colonist on the left.
LanguageData.ShiftChange_Msg_NoWardrobeOrPolicy: {0} has no wardrobe zone or apparel policy for this shift.
LanguageData.ShiftChange_Msg_EmptyWardrobe: {0} found no apparel in the wardrobe zone.
LanguageData.ShiftChange_Msg_ApparelClaimed: {0} — wardrobe pieces are reserved by another colonist.
